description: This file contains unit tests for the WPEFramework::Core data structures, specifically DataElement and LinkedDataElement, using the Google Test framework.

classes.name: DataElement
classes.description: A class representing a data element with methods for copying, sizing, CRC calculation, and other data manipulations.

classes.name: LinkedDataElement
classes.description: A class representing a linked data element, supporting linked list semantics.

classes.name: DataElementParser
classes.description: A class for parsing DataElement instances with methods to check validity and skip bytes.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data from an array or another DataElement.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Gets or sets the size of the DataElement.

methods.name: CRC32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum over a range of data.

methods.name: Buffer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the internal data buffer.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the DataElement is valid.

methods.name: SearchNumber
methods.description: Searches for a number within the data buffer.

methods.name: SetNumber
methods.description: Sets a number into the data buffer at a specified position.

methods.name: GetNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a number from the data buffer at a specified position.

methods.name: Search
methods.description: Performs a search operation within the data buffer.

methods.name: SetBitNumber
methods.description: Sets bits within the data buffer.

methods.name: GetBitNumber
methods.description: Retrieves bits from the data buffer.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets a value at a specific offset within the data buffer.

methods.name: Align
methods.description: Aligns the data buffer to a specific boundary.

methods.name: Shrink
methods.description: Reduces the size of the DataElement.

methods.name: Expand
methods.description: Expands the size of the DataElement.

methods.name: Enclosed
methods.description: Markers for setting or getting enclosed linked data elements.

methods.name: LinkedSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the linked data.

methods.name: LinkedElements
methods.description: Returns the number of linked elements.
